Leverage appears manageable with total liabilities at 57,728M versus total assets of 110,429M (~52%), and equity/retained earnings are positive, supporting resilience. Overall, these factors point to solid but not top-tier credit quality, consistent with a **BBB+** assessment.

DECISION: BBB+
